sahneler.metin: On approach to Washington Dulles, a Boeing 727 flew into a mountain.
Everyone aboard was killed, ninety two people.
The crew believed they were cleared to descend.
The clearance didn't make the safe altitude clear.
The jet had no terrain warning system.
Weeks earlier, another crew had nearly done the same.
Ground proximity warnings then became mandatory.

aciklama:
TWA 514 hit a mountain on approach to Washington Dulles. The cause: premature descent in cloud due to ambiguous approach clearance and charts.
